name: GGX Mixture NDF
aliases: Surface Normal Distribution Function (NDF) Mixture with SGGX
definition: A representation of the marginal distribution of surface normals $p_N(n)$ using a mixture of SGGX distributions to model glossiness and anisotropy.
summary: The GGX Mixture NDF models complex surface glossiness by combining multiple SGGX lobes, capturing multi-modal or highly anisotropic normal distributions that single-lobe methods cannot.
